message.content: An editorial magazine cover features an illustrated man from the chest up against a purple background. He wears a black peci cap, silver-rimmed glasses, a dark suit, and a dark necktie. His mouth is open, gripping a strip of light blue adhesive tape between his teeth. His right hand holds a roll of the same blue tape, while his left hand pulls a strip of it. Below him, a gray box sits in the foreground with the black letters "ACT" and the smaller green words "care for" printed on its side. Two strips of blue tape form an "X" on the box’s top surface. White text at the top left reads "Siasat Lili Mengakali Sanksi Gratifikasi H.62", while "100 Tahun Tamansiswa H.46" is on the right. Large white letters spell "TEMP" behind the man’s head, with "ENAK DIBACA D" underneath. On the bottom right, "DANA ACT MENGALIR JAUH" appears in large white letters above a smaller paragraph. A barcode, date, and price are in the bottom left corner.
